news.text: #Juventus will do everything they can - results permitting - to avoid changing managers until the end of the season. After that, regardless of where they finish, it appears highly unlikely that #Spalletti will stay beyond June 30. Antonio #Conte remains the dream of many fans, but keep an eye on Simone #Inzaghi as well.[Mirko Nicolino]

#SPALLETTI ON THE BRINKThe coach has lost #Juve: time-bound trust.Disastrous start, no more chances left. The nervous coach demands a clarification from #Bremer. The fans call for #Conte (who knows how to take over mid-season).[Front Page Gazzetta dello Sport]

LUCIO AND SHADOWS#Bremer apologizesThe flop against #Lazio, the rumors about #Conte and the harsh criticisms from the Brazilian.#Juve is with #Spalletti, but answers are needed.Delicate moment: the club acts as a shield. Confrontation between the coach and the squad at la Continassa. The captain was also called out: "We all lost, no one is excluded". #Rennes on Thursday. #Comolli goes to B: president of #Pisa.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#SPALLETTI MANDATORY TRUST#Juve has too many reasons to move forward with Lucio who challenges the ghost of #Conte and covers himself with a 3-man defense.Fans are furious with the coach, the team and the club, which in the meantime has fined #Bremer following his apology to his teammates. Until the international break, there are 6 matches to turn things around, starting with #Rennes this Thursday in the Europa League. But #Conceição is KO as well: dislocated shoulder.[Front Page TuttoSport]

👨‍🦲🆙 "#Spalletti: the trust continues, but a change of pace is absolutely expected. The results, the performances and the quality of play are not up to #Juventus standard. To date, zero imminent updates regarding a change: the situation should be monitored, but, for now, the club chooses to wait and hope for a turnaround. The club is also internally handling the locker room balance, a crucial aspect to understand what will happen next."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👨‍🦲🔴 "Within #Juventus, according to thorough checks we carried out today, there is no #Conte plan or any other manager lined up: the club wants to continue with #Spalletti and is firmly convinced that he is still the right coach. The trust has not been shaken by yesterday's game: the club is convinced that it is right to move forward and not consider other paths."[Di Marzio - Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 #Juventus has absolutely no intention of parting ways with Luciano #Spalletti following the defeat against #Lazio.The confidence in the bianconero coach was not affected by the clear 0-3 loss at the Allianz Stadium.For this reason, there are no alternative plans to the ex national team manager.The future, as well as the present, of #Juve will continue to rest with Luciano #Spalletti, who is looking for a reaction after a start to the season filled up with ups and downs.[@DiMarzio via @PuebloJ]

🎙 @guido_vaciago, director of @tuttosport, analyzed live on the program Il Processo the current state of #Juventus, from the defeat against #Lazio to the future of #Spalletti on the bianconero bench:#COMOLLI'S LEGACY"A part of #Juventus's problems was created by #Comolli.#Juve has to deal with an enormously complex set of problems that have stratified over at least 3 years of disastrous management, between players who are not up to standard and mistaken strategic decisions, which created this magnetic chaos in which the coaching issue is not the highest priority."#SPALLETTI'S FAULTS"I think #Juventus has a very complex problem and you cannot give simple solutions to complex problems.I don't

🤔🗣 Giovanni Guardalà on 'Sky Sport 📰': "#Spalletti's statements are particularly harsh and can be interpreted in two ways: either as a way to shake up the environment and express the bitterness of a post-game or almost as a signal of surrender. I don't believe it is. However if a coach says: 'Until yesterday I knew they were following me, today I don't know', and he said it with a particular tone - meaning it was also to respond in an almost provocative manner - I believe that when certain assertions are made, evidently there is something to it. And #Bremer's statements also make us think that the group, at this historical moment, is not particularly cohesive".[@juventusinsidernews]
#Juventus’ technical director Ricky #Massara is tonight at Moccagatta Stadium to watch the game between #Juve Next Gen and #Renate. #transfers[Nico Schira]

⚫️🔵 Damien Comolli signs in as new president and CEO at Italian second division side Pisa.[Fabrizio Romano]

⚠️❗️The defeat against #Lazio puts everyone under scrutiny, including #Spalletti, whose position is no longer so secure. The 8-point gap from the top is far from the management's expectations and an immediate turnaround is needed. The responsibility does not lie solely with the coach: the team has shown structural limitations and a regista was missing from the mercato. Meanwhile, the shadow of #Conte remains alive.[Niccolò Ceccarini - TMW via @juventusinsidernews]

#Conceição blow for #Juventus Glenohumeral dislocation of the left shoulder, which was already reduced yesterday night. The player will undergo conservative therapy and has already begun his rehabilitation process.A 3-week layoff, he will be back after the international break. @junews24com[Marco Baridon]

👀 "Luciano #Spalletti is heavily criticized and on thin ice, at risk of being sacked before the November international break if the poor results continue.However, his dismissal is complex due to the high financial cost of his contract and that of his coaching staff (close to €20M).He is criticized for his constant tactical changes and lineups, a lack of continuity and the fact that the team has not made a leap in quality after a year in charge.An absolute lack of leaders and high caliber players is being pointed out.#Bremer's statements show a lack of character and personality within the squad.The only player with the potential to be a top player is #Yildiz, who is currently injured and will

Medical Update | Francisco ConceicaoFollowing the injury to his left shoulder sustained during the match against Lazio, Francisco Conceicao underwent diagnostic tests this morning at J|medical.The tests revealed a glenohumeral dislocation, which had already been reduced yesterday evening. The player will undergo conservative treatment and has already begun a rehabilitation programme aimed at a return to competitive action.[Juventus]

🚨 Excl. - #Juventus are monitoring the striker Antonio #Raimondo (born in 2004), who has scored 7 goals in 7 matches during this #SerieA’s season. A #Juve’s scout was at Stirpe Stadium last Friday to watch Frosinone-Sassuolo. His contract with Bologna expires in 2028. #transfers[Nico Schira]

👀 "We could be nearing the end of the #Spalletti era at #Juventus due to the team's lack of identity, style of play and intensity.In the face of this crisis, the name of Antonio #Conte is being mentioned as the only possible solution or way out of this slump.Despite having brought in 9 new faces and renewing a large portion of the squad (disapproving the excuse of 'bad habits' in the dressing room), the team has worsened compared to last year.Even the objective of reaching fourth place to qualify for the Champions League is perceived as extremely complex."[@romeoagresti on YouTube via @PuebloJ]
